ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray to black) pixels covering approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized in specific linear and punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe features a distinct set of three high-intensity curvilinear parallel marks in the mid-lateral region. Left lobe exhibits diffuse light-gray mottling near the lower leading edge and a singular dark circular cluster near the upper trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks is greatest at the distal tips, transitioning to lower-frequency, rounded undulations toward the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curvature terminating in sharply tapered, upwardly-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, multi-pixel clusters with irregular texture located at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of surface-attached organisms or calcified scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, high-intensity curvilinear marks (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe; one subtle, dark vertical linear disruption on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant geometric indentation (notch) located on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; numerous smaller V-shaped tissue losses along both lobe margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark, circular high-contrast spot located on the upper left lobe, approximately 30% inward from the distal tip.
